5125.title: Hidden controls reduce parent-title width
5125.rootCauseOneLine: Parent rows permanently reserve the quick-action inset inside the title/disclosure flex container even while the action overlay is invisible.
5125.proposedFix: Decouple the disclosure target from hover-title insets after deciding disclosure/action placement; removing the inset alone recreates an Archive collision.
5125.caveats: Verified twice in clean source-development instances on Linux Chromium with fine-pointer launch flags; native macOS not tested. No automatic fix PR: the minimal candidate fails disclosure hit-target safety and a safe alternative needs a placement decision.
